state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk: every export of `nvs:intl/icu` works, both components are embedded, and the growth test and the bundle test pass.

Every `Novis\Intl` feature owes nothing: the nine classes (`Icu` and the eight job classes) and the 14 enums. Each enum has an about page and one example under `docs/examples/types/Novis-Intl-<Enum>/`, and a `covers:` line in an existing case under `tests/conformance/novis/intl-*.nvst`. `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 0` names no `Novis\Intl` feature.

Still red: `bun nv proofs --gate` over the whole roster, 196 features, none of them `Novis\Intl`. 182 are stale perf figures (`Core\BigInt`, `Core\Uri`, `Core\Time*`, `Core\Http*`, `Core\Crypto*`, `Core\Random*`, `Core\Uuid`). Each one is stale because its source file changed since it was measured, as `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Uuid::v4'` shows, so `--record-perf` re-measures it with no new file. The other 14: `Novis\Image\Diff::constructor`, `Image::mime`, `Image::extension`, `Codec::compare`, `::hash`, `::placeholder`, `::palette`, `::qr`, `Novis\Image\Output`, `ExtensionError`, `Core\DeprecatedError`, and the directives `errors.deprecated`, `image.max_pixels` and `ext`.

`--record-perf` refuses with "the calibration did not measure anything" when the machine is busy. Running it again a minute later worked.
